method: Consensus searches and fetched paper records; bibliographic and implementation checks against PubMed, original-paper PDF and NEURON hh.mod.

papers.title: Fluctuating temperatures and ectotherm growth: distinguishing non-linear and time-dependent effects
papers.supports: Nonlinear rate curves can yield different time-averaged responses at equal mean temperature.
papers.limit: The study concerns Manduca growth, not Chlorella oxygen flux. Exposure duration and thermal history can invalidate instantaneous averaging. The atlas demonstrates the mathematical effect conditional on its fitted rate curve.

papers.title: A quantitative description of membrane current and its application to conduction and excitation in nerve
papers.supports: Voltage-dependent channel gating, sodium inactivation, recovery and the classic temperature factor 3^((T-6.3)/10).
papers.limit: A spatially uniform squid-axon model. Temperature changes gating rates only; ion concentrations, reversal potentials and maximal conductances stay fixed. It does not fit the recorded mouse cells.

papers.title: The neural code between neocortical pyramidal neurons depends on neurotransmitter release probability
papers.supports: Release-dependent resource depletion, exponential recovery and saturation of mean synaptic output with firing rate.
papers.limit: The atlas uses a reduced one-pool mean-field approximation, R′=(1−R)/τ−U f R. Coupling U×R to the Howarth per-event ATP accounting is an illustrative extension, not an experimentally validated whole-cortex ATP trajectory.

papers.title: Multiple mechanisms govern the dynamics of depression at neocortical synapses of young rats
papers.supports: An explicit limit on the simplified depletion model: real cortical synapses also exhibit release-independent depression and activity-dependent recovery.
papers.limit: These mechanisms are not represented by the atlas's fixed recovery time.

extensions.checks: Convex/concave/linear known answers and independent SciPy adaptive quadrature versus browser periodic quadrature.
Gate-derivative factor identity and browser RK4 versus DOP853 voltage/gate trajectories.

extensions.calculation: Two 2 ms pulses separated by a 4–30 ms onset interval
extensions.checks: Exact current transitions, 1 versus 2 spike recovery cases, sodium block and independent integrators.
Analytic solution versus independent ODE, zero-firing recovery and per-component Python/browser ATP parity.
